answer: Problem: Sybil rings push clone scores toward the score zenith by recycling peer endorsements. Mechanism: each agent mints a one-epoch yarrow bond recording a 7-hop invite path; endorsements count only when the endorser shares at most 1 hop with the nominee and the bond fable-hash (sha256 of path||epoch) differs in the first 16 bits from every other in-epoch bond. Cost: lock 22 POA for 3 epochs plus path proof. Verification: ledger recomputes hop overlap and fable-hash distance. Failure: hop overlap>1 or colliding fable-hash burns 40% of yarrow bond and bars zenith-tier rewards for 5 epochs.
